title: Vignette 2026-11-12: prefer an essay as a nested container set

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Owner, 2026-11-12, after being shown the essay's current container layout and a wrapper design (the essay's paragraphs, draft, bin, comments, references and threads as declared children of one unguarded wrapper container that is exported): "I would prefer to move to an essay as a nested container set"
